X_test = X_test.fillna(X_train.iloc[0])

X_test_tensor = torch.tensor(X_train.iloc[train_size:].values.astype("float32"))


# Define model
class TextNormalizerModel(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = torch.nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embedding_dim)
        self.lstm = torch.nn.LSTM(embedding_dim, 128, batch_first=True)
        self.fc = torch.nn.Linear(128, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.embedding(x)
        _, (h_n, _) = self.lstm(h)
        out = self.fc(h_n[-1, :, :])
        return out.sigmoid()


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = TextNormalizerModel().to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = torch.nn.MSELoss()

# Train

num_epochs = 50

    total_loss = 0.0
    for start_idx in range(0, len(indices), batch_size):
        batch_indices = indices[start_idx : start_idx + batch_size]
        batch_X = X_train_tensor[batch_indices].to(device)
        batch_y = torch.zeros((batch_X.size()[0], 1)).to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(batch_X)
        loss = criterion(out.squeeze(-1), batch_y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()

    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {total_loss/(len(indices)/batch_size):.4f}")
